source_handle: *37 Local povidone-iodine disinfection and alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scrape the tooth extraction wound, suture it, and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
